name: HKG A-CDM
oneLiner: TOBT/TSAT shared clock for turnaround. Missing passenger is an A-CDM delay reason.
reconnectTakeaway: Never use the iPad wall clock. FIDS eventTime / sim clock only.

name: Reconnect (this repo)
oneLiner: Deterministic MCT engine + iPad triage + guarded draft. Pilot: Altéa read, FIDS MQTT, CANS push.
weaknesses: Incumbent collision if pitched as mass IROPS
reconnectTakeaway: The product is already the 2026 feasibility shape. The pitch must not throw it away.

name: Accenture Rebooking Experience
oneLiner: CX self-rebook chatbots in the typhoon stack: notify, then four steps to pick a preferred flight.
weaknesses: Not a transfer-desk queue; does not escort UM/WCH through T1
reconnectTakeaway: Chatbot self-rebook is already bought. Our send is agent-approved CANS, not a second bot.

name: 15below customer communication
oneLiner: Notification layer on CX disruption: once a new journey is accepted, 15below sends the new flight details.
strengths: CX already paid for proactive passenger comms
weaknesses: Mass notify, not last-90-minute special handling
reconnectTakeaway: CANS after human confirm sits beside 15below, not over it. Do not pitch a new notification platform.
